prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name and pick their personality traits before bringing them home.", "Pet Name", "Personality"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn the essential shortcuts and system tray actions to interact with or minimize your pet anytime.", "Desktop Controls & Shortcuts", "Welcome to Your Desktop!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen."]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Home...", "Your companion is being customized and loaded onto your desktop.", "Desktop Tips", "Generation Progress"]
3: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Select a ready-made companion or build your own custom pet from scratch.", "Ready Pets", "Creation Modes"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Signing in ensures your pet data, items, and progress are backed up safely.", "Use the same login account across sessions to keep your companion saved.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
5: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Use a clear, well-lit, front-facing photo for best custom pet generation.", "Photo Quality Tips"]
6: ["Desktop Setup Complete!", "Verify display permissions so your pet can freely walk on top of your open windows.", "Display & Overlay Permissions"]
7: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Complete onboarding to claim an exclusive bonus starter toy for your pet companion!", "Free Starter Accessory Included"]
8: ["Select Your Companion", "Browse available pets and test their unique sounds before making your choice.", "Pet Options", "Audio Preview"]
9: ["Generating Your Companion", "Feel free to minimize this app. We will notify you via system tray when your pet is ready!", "Custom pet loading usually takes 2 to 3 minutes.", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
